jobs.title: Product Operations Associate, Aladdin Platform Engineering
jobs.location: New York, NY; hybrid, at least 4 office days per week
jobs.salary: $105,000–$137,500 base plus discretionary bonus; fully above $100K
jobs.why: Associate-level Product Operations role coordinating planning, intake, milestone tracking, cross-functional alignment, reporting, product communications, documentation and workflow improvement. Audrey's Orion Salesforce BA projects involved cross-team requirements, backlog/UAT coordination, reporting, knowledge documentation and training; her Horizon Blue ABA work improved onboarding and staffing processes. Her prior reporting operations also supports the role's data and communications needs.
jobs.gap: No demonstrated ownership of engineering OKRs, platform product roadmaps, executive operating reviews or a product-wide communications cadence. Four office days weekly.

jobs.title: Product Operations Senior Associate
jobs.salary: $106,500–$145,500 base plus equity; range spans multiple levels, placement depends on experience
jobs.why: Product Operations bridge between customers, Product and Engineering, focused on turning usage feedback into requirements, investigating issues, coordinating alpha testing, release readiness, training and documentation. Audrey's Orion Salesforce BA/UAT, issue investigations, user documentation, stakeholder training and Horizon Blue ABA workflow automation align. Prior finance reporting and healthcare operations give relevant exposure to complex processes; employer welcomes SQL learners.
jobs.gap: No verified production SQL/log-based debugging, severity-1/2/3 incident ownership, mortgage servicing domain knowledge, direct enterprise SaaS customer escalation ownership, or independent release ownership.
